notes.manas-2010:p1131:b001:l007: Аяш катын denotes the wife of the speaker's friend; retained as that relationship, not an unrelated woman.
notes.manas-2010:p1131:b001:l012: Аяш уул is an affectionate relational address, rendered young friend; not a claim that Almambet is Akerkech's son.
notes.manas-2010:p1131:b001:l018: Улуу сөздө уят жок is a formula licensing frank speech; grave words is provisional, not an added moral judgment.
notes.manas-2010:p1131:b001:l024: The dough comparison is retained as part of the accusation; тамыр in the next row overlaps intimacy and sworn friendship.
notes.manas-2010:p1131:b001:l028: Marvels is bitterly ironic in the ensuing account of beating and humiliation.
notes.manas-2010:p1131:b001:l034: Sheep being driven over her is the witness's explicit image; no milder substitute.
notes.manas-2010:p1132:b001:l004: Талак кат is a divorce document; a letter of divorce preserves the object mentioned.
notes.manas-2010:p1132:b001:l008: Кер is rendered dark-bay provisionally; байтал is a young mare/filly, not a gelding.
notes.manas-2010:p1132:b001:l017: Taking another's troubles is an affectionate protective formula, not a claim that a literal transfer has occurred.
notes.manas-2010:p1132:b001:l021: Yudakhin күпчөк is a leather bucket, including camelhide, rather than a wheel hub in this context; the precise hide is not asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1132:b001:l025: Чапчак is the wooden vessel here; distinct from the leather күпчөк in l021.
notes.manas-2010:p1132:b001:l027: Чачама дары is glossed as a potent poison in the Kyrgyz academic Orozbakov 6–7 glossary search excerpt; its suggested narcotic character is conjectural there and no specific substance is named here.
notes.manas-2010:p1132:b001:l040: Айланган is provisionally affectionate circling/cherishing in the sworn-friendship context. The compressed phrase also allows a temporal reading of six years passing; the six years are retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1132:b001:l042: The source addresses the oath's curse to you and then to your friend at 1133:l002. This potentially awkward distribution is preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1133:b001:l020: Resting the head on a pillow is retained with the old-age explanation; it is not silently changed into a death announcement.
notes.manas-2010:p1133:b001:l024: The loss of eyebrows and the people's loss of their head form a paired image; both source lines retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1133:b001:l040: Alty-Shaar is a regional name literally six cities. Margalaң is retained as Margalang; no modern geographic itinerary imposed.
notes.manas-2010:p1134:b001:l004: The hoe-sized round bread at the waist is retained literally as the speaker's caricature.
notes.manas-2010:p1134:b001:l018: Күн чыгыш and күн батыш are read geographically as east and west in the landscape description.
notes.manas-2010:p1134:b001:l028: El-Sozduk's Yudakhin кунас and explanatory каракунас entries identify a stork. Separate stork wording at l031 is preserved, without forcing a precise species distinction.
notes.manas-2010:p1134:b001:l029: Суу бүркүтү literally water eagle; fish eagle is provisional, without a species identification.
notes.manas-2010:p1134:b001:l031: Илек-илек is the bird stork per the primary dictionary, not the epic multitude unit илек.
notes.manas-2010:p1134:b001:l038: Шай is read as supernatural or holy support in this heroic formula; no particular saint is supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1135:b001:l010: Ордо is the traditional knucklebone game here; no palace sense.
notes.manas-2010:p1135:b001:l021: Бадана is mail; torгой көз preserves the lark-eye comparison for its rings.
notes.manas-2010:p1135:b001:l022: Local 2010 glossary manas-2010:p1839:b001:l004 defines келеме бото as netted outerwear. Күрмө is rendered short coat; no invented armor material.
notes.manas-2010:p1135:b001:l024: Animal and copper comparisons describe the steed across the next two lines; line order retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1135:b001:l028: Printed огойду is contextually read as Ногойду, the Nogoy people, alongside Argyn and Kypchak. Raw source retained; correction is provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p1135:b001:l033: The willow image is retained even though the next clause resumes the list of companions abruptly.
notes.manas-2010:p1135:b001:l037: Бай is treated as Bakay's father's name in the genealogical formula, while the common noun also means rich man.
notes.manas-2010:p1136:b001:l007: Байчоро is retained as Baychoro; whether an epithet/alias linked with Chubak or a separate item in the compressed list is not resolved.
notes.manas-2010:p1136:b001:l011: Куту is the companion's short name, supported internally by Кутубий/Куту alternation, including 0846:l024. Not the common noun box.
notes.manas-2010:p1136:b001:l012: Үзүктөй describes a hat compared in size to a yurt roof-felt; repeated for Shuutu later.
notes.manas-2010:p1136:b001:l025: The twelve daughters and the speaker's explicit sibling claims are retained as this witness states them.
notes.manas-2010:p1136:b001:l041: The naked child at Kanykey's right shoulder is retained with Mother Umay's protection; no demythologizing explanation substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p1137:b001:l003: The source explicitly negates thoroughbred. The giving clause's subject and link to Shuutu remain compressed; no no-mere enhancement or invented horse name.
notes.manas-2010:p1137:b001:l007: The six letters are retained, along with the preceding not-once wording.
notes.manas-2010:p1137:b001:l028: The quotation ends with a subordinate fragment without a clear governing verb. No invented death, departure, or response completes the prediction.
notes.manas-2010:p1137:b001:l033: Козголбой literally not moving is retained despite surrounding journey verbs; no silent positive correction.
notes.manas-2010:p1138:b001:l020: Жел көкүрөк literally wind-chested is a contemptuous image for bluster, not anatomy asserted by the translator.
notes.manas-2010:p1138:b001:l025: The first-person plural proposal to take Akerkech as wife is retained, including its ambiguity; no softened consensual exchange substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p1138:b001:l031: Ач болот literally hungry steel is the weapon epithet, not a separate named character.
notes.manas-2010:p1138:b001:l032: Yudakhin сарынжы denotes a type of fur coat; an earlier same-agent draft armor guess was corrected.
notes.manas-2010:p1139:b001:l002: Printed Түрүү is contextually read as тирүү, alive; raw retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1139:b001:l005: The proposed extraction and striking with lungs is retained literally. The precise ritual function is not independently established here.
notes.manas-2010:p1139:b001:l018: The handles leaving the wrists is a literal provisional rendering of the printed image; no silent alteration to a paralysis formula.
notes.manas-2010:p1139:b001:l019: The heart's casing falling is retained as a fear image, not a medical claim.
notes.manas-2010:p1140:b001:l025: Суук укурук literally cold herding pole is read as thieving/seizing here in the horse-taking context; repeated at 1143:l034.
notes.manas-2010:p1140:b001:l033: Flour chewing is retained as the explicit oath action; not silently converted to ordinary eating.
notes.manas-2010:p1140:b001:l035: The oath twig is retained as a ritual object without substituting a modern document.
notes.manas-2010:p1141:b001:l013: The taunt's lame yellow horse is retained without normalizing it to Sarala's name or a different color.
notes.manas-2010:p1141:b001:l015: Энеңди ал is retained as a crude maternal insult literally take your mother. No specific sexual act added to the wording.
notes.manas-2010:p1141:b001:l021: Алтын жебе is provisionally a golden point in the axe description; not asserted as a separate weapon name.
notes.manas-2010:p1142:b001:l011: Аласын is read as their piebald horse from the pursuit context; horse is an English ellipsis expansion.
notes.manas-2010:p1142:b001:l022: The impending bullet is retained as the source's compressed prospective wording; no extra shot is inserted before Mazhik restrains him.
notes.manas-2010:p1143:b001:l002: Долоно is hawthorn; handle supplied from the adjacent whip action, not a new weapon.
notes.manas-2010:p1143:b001:l011: Жакетай is read as an affectionate respectful Kazakh address to an elder, not a newly introduced name.
notes.manas-2010:p1143:b001:l042: Ten directions is the source's hyperbolic tear image; the number is preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1144:b001:l014: The explanatory dictionary окоро describes a rounded knot in joined bridle straps/rope. Rounded knot replaces an unsupported generic loop.
notes.manas-2010:p1144:b001:l016: Erkech is the source's shortened form of Akerkech, not a new character.
notes.manas-2010:p1144:b001:l028: Yudakhin жекенди тон denotes a type of outer garment. No reed fabric or leather-belt sense imported from neighboring dictionary entries.
notes.manas-2010:p1144:b001:l029: Желмаян is a swift riding camel here; no independent named legendary camel asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1144:b001:l037: The two days beyond the appointment are retained; the narrated missed meeting remains as told.
notes.manas-2010:p1145:b001:l006: Being a guest and passing on without lingering are both retained in consecutive lines.
notes.manas-2010:p1145:b001:l032: Kögala reappears despite the preceding gift to Akerkech. The witness's name sequence is preserved; no substituted mount or invented explanation.
notes.manas-2010:p1145:b001:l034: Байда болду is contextually пайда болду, appeared; raw source retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1146:b001:l001: Буда is provisionally a blessing/prayer in the five spiritual masters context, likely a defective religious word; not interpreted as Buddha.
notes.manas-2010:p1146:b001:l014: The horse speaks of its own courser soul/life in the dream; Alake is the affectionate form of Almambet's name.
notes.manas-2010:p1146:b001:l037: Кыл этинде is read as lean racing condition in the horse formula, not literal hair flesh.
notes.manas-2010:p1146:b001:l039: The night/day reversal is preserved exactly; no chronology repair.
notes.manas-2010:p1146:b001:l040: Атымды койгон is read as who named me, not with whom I left my horse; the name/horse homonym is disambiguated by the earlier supernatural naming account.
notes.manas-2010:p1146:b001:l041: Кайып эрен and кырк чилтен are supernatural protectors/Forty Saints. One of is supplied to connect with the next source line's бири.
notes.manas-2010:p1147:b001:l011: Yudakhin чүчтө/чүштө and the explanatory dictionary identify white cambric; no silver-plating gloss.
notes.manas-2010:p1147:b001:l012: The pistachio comparison is retained without inventing whether it refers to shape, color, or texture.
notes.manas-2010:p1147:b001:l015: Акжолтой is auspicious here, not the companion Akzholoy's name.
notes.manas-2010:p1147:b001:l020: Honey-rinsed mouth is retained as the image accompanying Bakay's speech; no literal preparation instruction intended.
notes.manas-2010:p1147:b001:l024: Coming from behind is retained alongside l006 coming before him; the narration is not spatially harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p1148:b001:l015: Тараза is retained as the Scales star name; no identification with modern Libra rather than traditional Kyrgyz asterisms is asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1148:b001:l033: Кара көк is read in its nobility/lineage sense in the grouping of lords, not simply a color.
notes.manas-2010:p1148:b001:l040: Аса байлап describes tying high at the rail; no claim of hanging the horse by its neck.
notes.manas-2010:p1149:b001:l008: Бал кайнатып is rendered sweet as honey provisionally as praise of the cooked meat; no added recipe ingredient asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1149:b001:l020: Printed урдуусу is contextually нурдуусу, radiant, matching the same portrait formula at 1136:l031; raw retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1149:b001:l025: Кысыр эмди refers to the yearling suckled by a mare not bred that season; тай and тайлак are retained as horse and camel, not collapsed to one animal.
notes.manas-2010:p1149:b001:l033: Сиңди is younger sister/younger female kin or close relation. Close younger sister retains the address without independently asserting biological sisterhood despite different paternal names.
notes.manas-2010:p1150:b001:l019: Ак is read as God/the divine truth in the entrusting formula; the subject shifts in this compressed presentation scene.
notes.manas-2010:p1150:b001:l029: Printed ике is contextually нике, the marriage rite, with Quran recitation immediately before it. Raw retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1150:b001:l039: Долу is the recurring fiery/impetuous epithet for Kanykey, not a clinical diagnosis.
